title: Which room differences should a guest be able to compare quickly
body:
Open the fictional hotel's three-room example at desktop and mobile widths. Tell us which facts need clearer labels or a better comparison order. Please avoid sharing guest details or copying a hotel's images without permission. [Hotel Website Design](https://hotelwebsitedesign.uk/) maintains the component. Suggestions about presenting supplied access information are welcome; suitability decisions remain with the guest and provider.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Hotel-Website-Design/hotel-room-compare#readme), then run the documented example locally.
